<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <line x1="328" y1="208" x2="337" y2="197" stroke="#EEFF28" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="197" x2="346" y2="208" stroke="#EEFF28" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="337" y1="197" x2="337" y2="216" stroke="#EEFF28" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <rect x="20" y="277" width="350" height="101" rx="5" fill="#1f542c" opacity=".35"/>

    <text x="39" y="653" font-family="Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11.99px" font-weight="500" fill="#EEFF28">Maya Chen · Jul 26, 2026</text>
    <text x="310" y="653" font-family="Montserrat, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11.99px" font-weight="700" fill="#EEFF28">+$120.00</text>
  </g>

  <!-- button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="115" y="681" width="160" height="48" rx="5" fill="#1f542c" opacity=".35"/>
    <rect x="115" y="679" width="160" height="48" rx="5" fill="#EEFF28"/>

  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#367541"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="754" x2="370" y2="754" stroke="#EEFF28" stroke-width="1" opacity=".45"/>

  <circle cx="52" cy="824" r="2" fill="#EEFF28"/>
